purpose: Compare native from-scratch 300 K variable-cell MD for an ideal 8-atom diamond cell between official unmodified QE 7.4.1 and the QE 7.5 CAIMD-development build af7ebfc with caimd=.false., using no explicit input velocities.
scope_note: This tests native 300 K initialization followed by ordinary variable-cell Parrinello-Rahman dynamics. It is NOT a continuing Nose-thermostat comparison: QE 7.4.1 does not accept ion_temperature='nose' for PW vc-md.

common_temperature_mode.qe75_source_evidence: PW/src/input.f90 CASE('initial') present in both a11913a (pristine baseline) and af7ebfc; sets control_temp=.TRUE., temperature=tempw
common_temperature_mode.qe74_binary_evidence: string table of the QE 7.4.1 pw.x contains the ion_temperature keyword pool 'Initial|initial|Andersen|andersen|Berendsen|berendsen|reduce_t..|rescale_t..|rescaling|not controlled|not-controlled|not_controlled'; 'nose' is absent from that pool, consistent with the observed 'unknown ion_temperature nose' failure
common_temperature_mode.no_continuing_thermostat_evidence: PW/src/input.f90 CASE('vc-md') sets ntcheck=nstep+1 and only ion_temperature='rescaling' overrides it, so the vcmove velocity-rescaling branch (vcsubs.f90 ~line 1015) never triggers; tnosep=.false.
common_temperature_mode.determinism_note: QE randy() defaults to idum=0, so the Maxwell realization may be identical between versions; this is NOT assumed and the analysis compares statistically.

qe74.version_probe: pw.x --version produced no output on the login node; version taken from the module name and the binary string '7.4.1'

structure.note: ideal starting structure, NOT a terminal state from a failed/heated trajectory

slurm.sequential: QE 7.4.1 first, then QE 7.5; the QE 7.5 run proceeds even if QE 7.4.1 fails

analysis_validation: scripts/analyze_comparison.py parsers were tested locally against the previously completed Leonardo run and reproduced its known values: 1000 eal rows, initial 300.0013 K, max 8123.839 K, final 4231.686 K, volume change +0.3025%, condition number max 1.01697
